In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] [[Metallurgy/Legends|metallurgist]] [[Ketrian Altronel]] created a new '''alloy''' based around [[ostrine]]. By using new method of crystalline and plas-bonding, the alloy increased the resulting alloy's heat-absorption tenfold.<ref name="Firepower">{{JournalCite|8|Firepower}}</ref>
